svg.title: B1 recorder loss and durable writer progress
svg.text: B1 recorder loss and durable writer progress
Retail cumulative counters by flush-ledger ordinal. The horizontal axis is not elapsed time.
Cumulative maximum FlushFileBuffers duration (raw and ACK calls combined):
33.82 ms initially; 287.58 ms by ACK 2; 1,206.57 ms by ACK 20. Timing of the maximum call is unresolved.
Queue high-water lower bound reaches 1,024; no retry-exhaustion or output fault. 89 producer retries are reported.
Counter snapshots are non-atomic. ACK metrics precede their own append/flush; their acknowledged field lags one ACK.
39 validated prefixes finalize all admitted records. No lost-event rate or exact queue-occupancy trace is available.
